Story.title: Story
Story.description: An audio story entry with metadata and external/public audio chapter links.

keywords.description: Bounded list of up to 20 searchable keywords.

chapters.description: Ordered list of chapters with playable audio URLs.

isPublished.description: Whether the story is visible on the public listener catalog.

isLocked.description: Whether this story requires a password to view and listen.

accessSalt.description: Random hex salt for PBKDF2 key derivation when locked.

lockedPayload.description: AES-GCM encrypted chapters and description payload when locked.

lockedChapterCount.description: Chapter count metadata shown before unlock.

createdBy.description: Admin UID who created the story.

StoryAdminVault.title: StoryAdminVault
StoryAdminVault.description: Admin-only private vault storing decrypted chapters, description, and lock password for password-protected stories.

description.description: Unencrypted story synopsis for admin editing.

chapters.description: Unencrypted chapter list for admin management.

lockPassword.description: Story access password managed by admin.

updatedBy.description: Admin UID who last updated the vault.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: A story classification label managed by admin.

createdBy.description: Admin UID who created the category.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Admin allowlist entry keyed by UID.

/stories/{storyId}.description: Publicly readable published audio story catalog; locked stories store encrypted payloads; writable only by verified admin.

/stories/{storyId}/adminVault/{docId}.description: Admin-only private vault for password-protected stories.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable story categories; writable only by verified admin.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only self/admin lookup table for role verification.
